references.text: Judah commands Onan to fulfill his duty as a brother-in-law (levirate marriage) and raise offspring for his deceased brother Er.
God's judgment on Onan for his evil deed – the Lord also caused him to die.
The law of levirate marriage: a brother's obligation to raise offspring for his deceased brother, and the consequences of refusing this duty.
Boaz redeems Ruth through levirate marriage – a positive example of the duty that Onan refused to fulfill.
